name: Mitre of Benevolence
body:
Aura transmutation; CL 5th; Slot head; Price 8,000 gp; Weight 4 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This large, ornate headgear bears symbols of goodness and service, but is can be cumbersome, extending a full foot into the air. An evil wearer suffers a -2 penalty to armor class when it is worn, which disappears if removed. It grants the wearer a +1 sacred armor bonus, and radiates an aura of guidance and virtue for 30 ft.; those within it are affected by those spells, which are renewed each minute, and are not cumulative.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells guidance, protection from evil, virtue; Cost 4,000 gp
